svg.title: Semax: from rat memory peptide to stroke drug
svg.desc: 1981: USSR patent 939440: heptapeptide as a long-acting memory stimulant; 1986: First PubMed paper: ACTH(4-10) analog has no hormonal (steroid) activity; 1994: RU 2045958: 'Semax' nasal drops as a nootropic; 303 people in 5 clinics; 1996: Human EEG study of semax (PubMed: title only); 1997: Acute stroke: 30 semax patients vs 80 controls, developers co-author; 1999: Stroke follow-up described as 'retrospective comparative'; 2018: Recovery-phase stroke, 110 patients, BDNF + Barthel, no placebo; 2025: Current Russian registrations: 0.1% (Mar) and 1% (Jun), Peptogen

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
